sources.note: No phonology section for Amira. Introduction notes only: (p.2-3) Schadeberg's Talodi-group transcriptions [Lafofa data] 'Tonal systems in the languages usually involve two registers, and the low register.. usually remains unmarked; we consistently mark it with the low tone diacritic'; for the Amira source 'The degree of phonetic accuracy here is uncertain, and the notation is sometimes unclear' (MacDiarmid ĕ = ɛ, th/dh, c/j reinterpretations). Amira forms (fewer than 70 Swadesh slots) carry no tone or stress marks; 'information on Lafofa verbal morphology is minimal, and on Amira non-existent…

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2016. Tegem-Amira: a previously unrecognised subgroup of Niger-Congo. Ms., draft circulated for comment (McDonald Institute, Cambridge), 26 pp.
sources.note: Nothing. No stress, no tone marking for Amira.
